`final class DrawText`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.draw.text` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [DrawText.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/draw/text/DrawText.java)

Draws and measures text, on one line or wrapped in a box.

## Description

Reach it through `DrawUtils.TEXT`.
Positions and sizes are in design pixels; every method returns the bounds of what it drew, and a text cut or wrapped to fit a box returns the width of the box.
Markup tags inside the text are never cut in half when a line wraps or is cut, and the elements of a [`Text`](/reference/text/text/) share one baseline.

## Method details

<a id="DrawText-method-drawText"></a>

### drawText

`FontBounds drawText(double x, double y, Text text)` 

Draws the text on one line, placed around `x`, `y` by its alignment: `START` puts its left or top edge there, `CENTER` its middle, `END` its right or bottom edge.

`FontBounds drawText(double x, double y, double width, double height, Text text, TextMode mode)` 

Draws the text in the box at `x`, `y` of `width` × `height`, aligned inside it, with the given [`TextMode`](/reference/text/textmode/).

`FontBounds drawText(double x, double y, String text, TextInfo info, Align alignX, Align alignY)` 

Draws a string on one line with `info`, placed around `x`, `y` by the horizontal and vertical alignments.

`FontBounds drawText(double x, double y, double width, double height, String text, TextInfo info, Align alignX, Align alignY, TextOverflow overflow, TextMode mode)` 

Draws a string in a box, with its alignments, its overflow marker and its mode.

<a id="DrawText-method-getLines"></a>

### getLines

`List<Text> getLines(double width, Text text)` 

Splits the text into the lines that `SPLIT` draws for `width`, each a [`Text`](/reference/text/text/) with the same alignment and overflow.
A line breaks at a line break or a `<br>` tag, otherwise at the last space that fits; only a word wider than the whole line is cut.

`List<String> getLines(double width, String text, TextInfo info)` 

Splits a string into the lines that fit `width` with `info`.
